title: Grade 6 French — Tue, May 19
description: Les chiffres (Numbers) — Day 2 of 5: 21–100 and ordinals
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 21 in French?
questions.explanation: 'Vingt et un' = 21. Numbers ending in 1 (21, 31, 41, 51, 61, 71) use 'et' (and): vingt ET un. Other multiples don't use 'et'.

questions.question: How is 22 written in French?
questions.explanation: 'Vingt-deux' = 22. From 22-29, use 'vingt-' + number with a hyphen. Only 21 uses 'et'.

questions.question: What is 'trente' in numbers?
questions.explanation: 'Trente' = 30. The tens in French: vingt(20), trente(30), quarante(40), cinquante(50), soixante(60).

questions.question: How do you say 50 in French?
questions.explanation: 'Cinquante' = 50. Note the spelling: cinqu-ante. The pattern for tens up to 60 is quite regular.

questions.question: 70 in French is unique. How is it formed?
questions.explanation: French has no unique word for 70! It's 'soixante-dix' (sixty-ten = 70). This is the famous quirk of French counting.

questions.question: How do you say 80 in French?
questions.explanation: 'Quatre-vingts' = 80 (literally 'four twenties' = 4×20). Another French counting quirk! Note: 'vingts' loses the 's' when followed by another number: quatre-vingt-un (81).

questions.question: How do you say 100 in French?
questions.explanation: 'Cent' = 100. Used in: cent un (101), deux cents (200, note the 's'), deux cent un (201, no 's').

questions.question: What is the ordinal number for 'first' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Premier' (m) / 'Première' (f) = first. All other ordinals add '-ième': deuxième(2nd), troisième(3rd), etc.

questions.question: How do you say 'third' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Troisième' = third. Ordinals are formed by adding '-ième' to the cardinal number. Note: troisième not 'trois-ème'.

questions.question: 'Je suis en cinquième classe.' What grade is this?
questions.explanation: 'Cinquième' = fifth. 'Je suis en cinquième classe' = 'I am in fifth grade'. 'Cinquième' is the ordinal of 'cinq' (5).

questions.question: Which correctly expresses 71?
questions.explanation: 'Soixante et onze' = 71. After 70 (soixante-dix), 71 = soixante ET onze (uses 'et'), 72 = soixante-douze, etc.

questions.question: Which number is 'quatre-vingt-cinq'?
questions.explanation: 'Quatre-vingts' = 80, 'cinq' = 5. So 'quatre-vingt-cinq' = 85. (Note: no 's' on vingt when followed by a number.)

questions.question: How would you say 'the second door' in French?
questions.explanation: 'La deuxième porte' = the second door. Ordinal 'deuxième' comes before the noun and agrees in gender: le deuxième/la deuxième.
